findings.evidence: These bold labels head their sections visually, but dom-1440 lists only h1 'Northline weekly ops' and h2 'Reach them', 'Campaign tracker', 'Finish your review'; the first three sections have no heading.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: heading navigation skips the most important sections.

findings.evidence: Sweep sees td.positive and td.negative classes on Change cells, but the tile shows '12%', '4%', '1%' all in the same black with no sign or arrow: the direction of change is not shown at all, visually or in text.
findings.after: −12% down with a visible sign or arrow
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 1.4.1 Use of Colour: meaning held only in a class name reaches no one. Nearest curated card A11-001.

findings.evidence: Sweep selector shows 'button.filter.active' on All, but in tile 1440-00 the three buttons look identical; no visible or (from the DOM capture) programmatic selected state.
findings.after: <button class="filter" aria-pressed="true">All</button> plus a visible selected style (filled background or underline)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 1.4.1 Use of Colour: current filter state is not perceivable.

findings.evidence: Button accessible name is 'Remove' (focus stop 4); out of context it does not say what is removed.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.6 Headings and Labels; 2.5.3 is kept because the visible word starts the name.

findings.evidence: 27 links named only 'before' (sweep repeated_label) and the 'Account' column header is itself a link with no stated purpose; a links list reads 'before, before, before...'.
findings.after: Make the Repo cell a row header (<th scope="row">) so 'before' is programmatically tied to its repo, or add aria-label="html-style before".
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context): table cells need a row header for the context to count.

findings.evidence: Verified sweep overflow hit: the table pushes the page to 773px at a 375px viewport; the whole page scrolls sideways, not just the table.
findings.after: Wrap the table in <div role="region" aria-label="Campaign tracker" tabindex="0" style="overflow-x:auto">
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow: data tables may scroll, but inside their own container, not the page.

strengths: Native buttons, links and <details> ('How this note was chosen') mean keyboard operation works without custom script.
Underlined body links are distinguishable without colour; lang=en and a header/footer are present.
not_investigated: The 'Review required 1/5' chip and 'Finish your review' form (three unlabelled inputs and a textarea in dom-1440) look like an injected review widget, not page content; their labels were not judged. Sweep contrast hit on its '1/5' (4.22:1, 11px) is real for that widget.
No live keyboard test of the filter buttons or the review widget.
